decision_rule_reachability.reason: The frozen pure classifier (cost_verdict + aggregate) was driven with synthetic rows at DESIGN time (--reachability-probe) and produced every class branch {STRICT-WIN, BOUNDED-WIN, MIXED-TRADEOFF, COST-FAIL, FUNCTIONAL-FAIL, COST-UNKNOWN} and every aggregate decision {SUPPORTS, SUPPORTS-BOUNDED, MIXED-TRADEOFF, MIXED, FALSIFIES, INCONCLUSIVE}; all_class_branches_reachable=true and all_aggregate_branches_reachable=true. No branch is shadowed: the aggregate precedence falls through from positive to negative tiers in order, and MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via any V-gate. The substantive positive branch (STRICT-WIN) is realizable on this system: the mechanics probe yields repair product=17 vs cold 18/19 at L=2/L=3 (ratios ~0.944/~0.895). The negative/neutral branches are realizable if the repair path necessarily re-resolves (T-REPAIR-CONSERVATIVE yields 1.0/~0.947). The classifier is satisfiable, non-tautological, and empirically open.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All hard prerequisites verified at DESIGN time. (a) Python 3.12 stdlib only; the shipped carrier imports cleanly (src/spider/kernel.py, models.py, registry.py compile and execute). (b) The DESIGN liveness probe (--liveness-only) returned server_ready=true, distill_live=true, task_read_verified=true, nc_no_perturbation_stale=false, nc_noise_stale=false; the mechanism distills from LEARN_IDS and resolves EXECUTABLE on TASK_IDS under the inferred support ^1[0-9]{1}$. (c) The carrier counter surface (TrajectoryCounters.add with fields {http_requests, retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts}) is confirmed to exist and operate. (d) No external task bank/dataset/fixture is read; the substrate is built inside the frozen runner. (e) The repair-signal unit probe (--reachability-probe.repair_signal_probe) produced a patched mechanism and probe body for all three perturbation classes (P1, P2, P3). No confirmatory/outcome-bearing measurement was run during DESIGN.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The cost denominator is fixed in advance to B-COLD (cold re-derivation of the SAME carrier), never the B-NO-REPAIR abstention and never the fetch ratio quoted alone. B-COLD is strong (success 1.0 expected, V5>=0.90) and distinct from the treatment which shares the same carrier, substrate, seeds and perturbations, differing only in the physical number of resolve/fetch/verify operations for the first task id. T-REPAIR-CONSERVATIVE and T-REPAIR-LEGACY are controls/sensitivities, explicitly excluded from the classifier, so they cannot silently become comparators. The treatment/comparator identity is therefore well defined and identifiable.

control_sensitivity.reason: Distinct, non-tautological controls cover each failure mode and were observed in the mechanics probe: Positive control PC-BASE-LIVENESS (task_read_verified=true). Perturbation-bites control B-LITERAL-REPLAY must fail (<=0.10); mechanics probe shows literal_success=false on all three classes. Abstention control B-NO-REPAIR must fail; mechanics probe shows norepair_success=false. Guard-specificity controls NC-NO-PERTURBATION and NC-NOISE must NOT fire (observed stale=false/false in both liveness and mechanics probes), while the deterministic guard must fire >=0.80 on perturbed trials (mechanics probe: repair_guard_fired=true on all three). Over-broad control NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR must be detected as contaminated (mechanics probe shows contamination_n=0 for targeted repair; overbroad contamination will be measured at n=12). Replication control T-REPAIR-LEGACY must reproduce the prior >1.00 at L=2 (mechanics probe: legacy product=20 vs cold_min=18, ratio=1.111 > 1.00). No control contains the answer supplied to the treatment.
evidence_refs: mechanics_probe_output: literal_success=false, norepair_success=false, nc_no_perturbation_stale=false, nc_noise_stale=false, legacy_ratio_L2=1.111

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment arm (T-REPAIR-REUSE) is structurally capable of becoming EXECUTABLE. It uses the same shipped carrier that the DESIGN liveness probe executed end-to-end (distill_parameterized -> resolve EXECUTABLE -> fetch 200 -> verify True), and the synthetic repair-signal probe showed local_repair produces a patched mechanism and probe body for all three perturbation signals. The mechanics probe confirms repair_success=true, conservative_success=true, legacy_success=true, guard_fired=true, contamination_n=0 on all three classes. The prior audited packet (EXP-GRAPH-38197849043, audit PASS) showed this carrier's repair succeeds 12/12 on perturbed resources with contamination 0/48. The mandate's reuse semantics do not weaken liveness (they only reduce the charged operations). Self-attack recorded: (i) if the repair routine mis-parses a live signal the class falls to FUNCTIONAL-FAIL, which is a reportable outcome, not a design break; (ii) if the carrier's inferred support rejected the task ids, resolve would EXPLORE and no trial would execute, so the DESIGN liveness probe explicitly verifies a task read resolves+verifies under the current banks (TASK_IDS in-support; verified true); (iii) the treatment's advantage depends on the repair not being forced to re-resolve - this is bounded and disclosed by the T-REPAIR-CONSERVATIVE surface.
evidence_refs: mechanics_probe_output: repair_success=true on all three classes, guard_fired=true, contamination_n=0

rationale: All six satisfiability/identifiability checks pass. The decision rule is reachable in all branches, all measurement prerequisites are satisfied with stdlib-only infrastructure, the strong baseline (B-COLD) is identifiable and distinct from the treatment, controls are sensitive and non-tautological, the treatment is live and executable, and all mutable interpretation dependencies are bound in freeze_artifacts. The mechanics probe confirms the expected cost arithmetic: T-REPAIR-REUSE product=17 vs B-COLD 18 (L=2) and 19 (L=3), yielding ratios ~0.944 and ~0.895 (STRICT-WIN achievable), while T-REPAIR-LEGACY reproduces the prior regression (ratio 1.111 at L=2). The experiment is ready to freeze.
